email.subject: Quick fix for Pistons Auto Care's site
email.body:
Hi Maria,

I checked Pistons Auto Care's website and found a couple of things likely costing you customers. Your photos are 10-13MB each, so on a phone the page can take 10+ seconds to load - most people give up before it does. The site also isn't built for mobile screens, where most "auto repair near me" searches happen. On top of that, the footer still shows 2022, which can make visitors wonder if you're still open.

I fix these kinds of issues for local businesses for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough of what's slowing your site down?

Alex
Northlight Web
